build_game_master: build a GameMaster prefab entity for a spaceship simulation game using a language model and memory bank
configure_spaceship_systems: configure oxygen and power generator spaceship systems with failure probabilities and warning messages
set_acting_order: set the acting order for players to game master choice, fixed, or random
add_extra_components: add extra components to the game master with custom insertion indices in the component order
customize_event_resolution: customize event resolution steps by providing comma-separated thought chain step names
